_comment: SPEC §16 - fully configurable weighting. Overall score components must sum to 1.0. Penalties are applied AFTER the weighted sum and are absolute point deductions.

penalties._comment: SPEC §16. hard_coding_violation of -100 is intended to floor the score at/near zero.

filters._comment: User-requested prestige filter. NOTE THE TENSION: SPEC §30 says career fit must be able to beat ranking, and the measured evidence says a master's is named in only ~5% of real postings - so employer demand for prestige is weak for THIS career. The filter is therefore applied as a visible gate with the excluded programmes still listed, not as a silent deletion. Set enforce_rank_filter to false to restore pure career-fit ranking.
filters.rank_source: ESTIMATED - QS ranks in programmes.seed.json were carried in from general knowledge and have NOT been verified against qs.com this run. Verify before treating the filter output as authoritative.

penalty_thresholds._comment: Tunable trigger points for the penalties above. extreme_cost_tuition_eur is the point at which a programme counts as expensive. weak_roi_ratio is judged against the §14 ratio, whose numerator is GROSS salary over the horizon - so a ratio of 4.0 still means roughly a quarter of five years' gross earnings goes on the degree. Anything below that is genuinely weak, not merely unimpressive.

career_score._comment: SPEC §11. Component weights within Career Score; normalised to 100.

personal_fit._comment: SPEC §12. Component weights within Personal Fit; normalised to 100.

country_score._comment: SPEC §13. Each sub-score is 0-10 in countries.json.

application_priority._comment: SPEC §47. Weighted blend; deadline urgency is computed from days remaining.

money_vs_purpose._comment: SPEC §53. Two separate scores plus a balanced blend using profile.preferences.balance.

admission_probability_points._comment: Maps the §15 band to a 0-100 number for use in the weighted overall score.

roi._comment: SPEC §14. opportunity_cost_annual_eur is the salary foregone while studying. Stated as an assumption, not a fact.
roi.opportunity_cost_source: ASSUMPTION - approximate current Union Bank of India total compensation converted to EUR. Update in config; not a verified figure.
